question: How much lighter is the multilayer urea crystal with both layers at 400 °C than the single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C?
rendered:
According to Table 7, the mass of the multilayer urea crystal with both layers at 400 °C is 2.947 g. According to Table 3, the mass of the single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C is 4.897 g. 

The difference in mass is 4.897 g - 2.947 g = 1.95 g. 

To find how much lighter the multilayer urea crystal is, we subtract the mass of the multilayer crystal from the mass of the single-layer standard group 2 crystal: 4.897 g - 2.947 g = 1.95 g. 

The multilayer urea crystal with both layers at 400 °C is 1.95 g lighter than the single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C.
